bayerlink_rx.description: The bayerlink receiver, generated for its capacity: parallel video in, one sample per beat out, the header's facts beside it.

link_reset.description: Holds the pixel domain in reset while the link is down, released synchronously once the recovered clock has settled.

rx_axis.description: The receiver's elastic stream dressed as AXI4-Stream: sample, eol and sof in one 32-bit word, a packet per frame.

SAMPLE_BITS.description: The width of one sample: the depth the receiver aligns every source to.

axis_unpack.description: The inverse of rx_axis: the AXI4-Stream word back into the elastic stream.

SAMPLE_BITS.description: The width of one sample: the depth the receiver aligns every source to.

stream_switch.description: One elastic stream, two consumers, a register choosing which.

SAMPLE_BITS.description: The width of one sample: the depth the receiver aligns every source to.

axis_spy.description: A pass-through AXI4-Stream spy: who refuses, the producer or the consumer.

ddc_phy.description: The DDC's pins: open-drain SDA, input-only SCL.

ddc_slave.description: The DDC slave, generated: the receiver's own EDID at 0x50 and an AXI master at 0x37.
